question.en: Who in a light motor vehicle is legally required to wear a seatbelt while traveling on a public road?
question.af: Wie in 'n ligte motorvoertuig is wettig verplig om 'n veiligheidsgordel te dra terwyl hulle op 'n openbare pad ry?
question.xh: Ngubani kwimoto encinci okufuneka anxibe ibhanti lokhuseleko ngokomthetho ngexesha ehamba kwindlela yoluntu?
question.zu: Ubani emotweni encane okumele agqoke ibhande lokuphepha ngokomthetho ngesikhathi ehamba emgwaqweni womphakathi?
question.st: Ke mang ka koloing e nyane ya bolulo ya setjhaba ya tlamehang ka molao ho apara lebanta la tshireletso ha a tsamaya tseleng ya setjhaba?
question.tn: Ke mang mo koloing e nnye yo o pateletsegang ka molao go apara lebanta la tshireletso fa a tsamaya mo tseleng ya setshaba?

en.A: A) Every occupant in a seat fitted with a seatbelt.
en.B: B) Only the driver.

af.A: A) Elke insittende in 'n sitplek toegerus met 'n veiligheidsgordel.
af.B: B) Slegs die bestuurder.

xh.A: A) Wonke umntu ohleliyo kwisihlalo esifakelwe ibhanti lokhuseleko.

zu.A: A) Wonke umuntu ohlezi esihlalweni esifakelwe ibhande lokuphepha.

st.A: A) Motho e mong le e mong ya dutseng setulong se nang le lebanta la tshireletso.
st.B: B) Mokgweli feela.
st.C: C) Bapalami ba pele feela.

tn.A: A) Motho mongwe le mongwe yo o ntseng mo setulong se se nang le lebanta la tshireletso.
tn.B: B) Mokgweetsi fela.
tn.C: C) Bapalami ba fa pele fela.

explanation.en: It is mandatory for all occupants (driver and all passengers) to wear seatbelts where fitted.
explanation.af: Dit is verpligtend vir alle insittendes (bestuurder en alle passasiers) om veiligheidsgordels te dra waar dit toegerus is.
explanation.xh: Kuyimfuneko ngokomthetho ukuba bonke abakhweli (umqhubi nabakhweli bonke) banxibe amabhanti okhuseleko apho efakiwe.
explanation.zu: Kuyimfuneko ngokomthetho ukuthi bonke abagibeli (umshayeli nabo bonke abagibeli) bagqoke amabhande okuphepha lapho efakiwe.
explanation.st: Ho hlokahala ka molao hore bapalami bohle (mokgweli le bapalami bohle) ba apare mabanta a tshireletso moo a fumanehang.
explanation.tn: Go a tlhokega ka molao gore bapalami botlhe (mokgweetsi le bapalami botlhe) ba apare mabanta a tshireletso kwa a fitlhelwang teng.

question.en: Which foot pedal in a manual transmission light motor vehicle is operated exclusively using the left foot?
question.af: Watter voetpedaal in 'n ligte motorvoertuig met handrat-oordrag word uitsluitlik met die linkervoet bedien?
question.xh: Yiyiphi ipedali yonyawo kwimoto encinci enegiya elenziwa ngesandla esebenza ngonyawo lwasekhohlo kuphela?
question.zu: Iyiphi ipedali yonyawo emotweni encane enegiya elenziwa ngesandla esebenza ngonyawo lwesobunxele kuphela?
question.st: Ke pedale efe ya leoto ho koloi e nyane e nang le phetoho ya magiya e etswang ka letsoho e sebediswang ka leoto le letshehadi feela?
question.tn: Ke petale efe ya lonao mo koloing e nnye e e nang le go fetola magia ka seatla e e dirisiwang ka lonao lwa molema fela?

en.A: A) Clutch pedal.
en.B: B) Service brake pedal.

af.A: A) Koppelaarpedaal.
af.B: B) Diensrempedaal.

xh.A: A) Ipedali yeklashi.

zu.A: A) Ipedali yekhulushi.

st.A: A) Pedale ya clutch.
st.B: B) Pedale ya boreka ba tshebeletso.
st.C: C) Pedale ya sepitikara.

tn.A: A) Petale ya kelase.
tn.B: B) Petale ya boreka jwa tirelo.
tn.C: C) Petale ya sepitikara.

explanation.en: The left foot operates only the clutch pedal, while the right foot operates brake and accelerator.
explanation.af: Die linkervoet bedien slegs die koppelaarpedaal, terwyl die regtervoet die rem en versneller bedien.
explanation.xh: Unyawo lwasekhohlo lusebenzisa kuphela ipedali yeklashi, ngelixa unyawo lwasekunene lusebenzisa ibhreki nesantya.
explanation.zu: Unyawo lwesobunxele lusebenzisa ipedali yekhulushi kuphela, kanti unyawo lwesokudla lusebenzisa ibhuleki nesevinini.
explanation.st: Leoto le letshehadi le sebedisa feela pedale ya clutch, ha leoto le letona le sebedisa boreka le sepitikara.
explanation.tn: Lonao lwa molema lo dirisa fela petale ya kelase, mme lonao lwa moja lo dirisa boreka le sepitikara.

question.st: Ha o kgweletsa koloi e nyane, o tlameha ho supa neng morero wa hao wa ho fetoha kapa ho fetola mmila?

en.C: C) Speed up to stay ahead of it.

st.C: C) Akgehla ho hlola o le pele ho yona.

tn.B: B) Tshegetsa lobelo lwa gago le boemo jwa mmila.
tn.C: C) Akofisa gore o nne kwa pele ga yone.

questions.code_name: Code 2 - Light Motor Vehicles (Code 8 / Class B)

question.en: What does a yellow painted crisscross box marking at an intersection (Sign RM10 / Box Junction) mandate?
question.af: Wat vereis 'n geel geverfde kruis-boksmerk by 'n kruising (Teken RM10 / Boks-kruising)?
question.xh: Yintoni eyimpoqo ephawulwe luphawu lwebhokisi eliyimifanekiso emitshixo etyheli kwindawo yenkupho (Uphawu RM10 / Indawo Yebhokisi)?
question.zu: Yini eyimpoqo ephawulwe uphawu lwebhokisi eliphuzi elinamayunithi axhumene esiphambanweni (Uphawu RM10 / Ukuhlangana kweBhokisi)?
question.st: Ke eng se qobelletsweng ke leswao la lebokoso le mosehla le pentilweng le nang le mela e kgatanang mahlakanong (Sesupo RM10 / Mahlakano a Lebokoso)?
question.tn: Ke eng se se patelesegang ke letshwao la lebokoso le lo serolwane le le penteletsweng le le nang le mela e e kgabaganang kwa mahakanelong (Letshwao RM10 / Mahakanelo a Lebokoso)?

en.A: A) Do not enter the yellow box unless your exit route is completely clear.
en.B: B) Mandatory stop for all turning vehicles.
en.C: C) Reserved space for emergency vehicles.

af.A: A) Moenie die geel boks binnegaan tensy jou uitgangsroete heeltemal oop is nie.

zu.A: A) Ungangeni ebhokisini eliphuzi ngaphandle kokuthi indlela yakho yokuphuma ivulekile ngokuphelele.

zu.C: C) Isikhala esigciniwe sezimoto zesimo esiphuthumayo.

st.C: C) Sebaka se boletsweng bakeng sa dikoloi tsa tshohanyetso.

tn.B: B) Go ema go go patelesegang go dikoloi tsotlhe tse di fetogang.
tn.C: C) Lefelo le le beetsweng dikoloi tsa tshoganyetso.

explanation.xh: Abaqhubi akufuneki bangene kwibhokisi etyheli edibeneyo ngaphandle kokuba umgca wabo wokuphuma ungenazithuthi.
explanation.zu: Abashayeli akufanele bangene ebhokisini eliphuzi elihlangeneyo ngaphandle uma umgwaqo wabo wokuphuma ungenazimoto.
explanation.st: Bakgweli ha ba a lokela ho kena lebokosong le lesehla mahlakanong ntle le haeba mmila wa bona wa ho tswa o hlakile sephethephetheng.
explanation.tn: Bakgweetsi ga ba a tshwanela go tsena mo lebokosong le lo serolwane kwa mahakanelong fa e se gore mmila wa bone wa go tswa o phepafetse mo sephethephetheng.

question.xh: Nguwuphi umlinganiselo osezantsi osemthethweni wobunzulu betayara ofunekayo kubo bonke ububanzi nakwiindawo ezijikelezayo zetayara yemoto encinci?
question.zu: Yikuphi ukujula okuphansi okusemthethweni kwe-tayer okudingekayo ebubanzini nasekuzungezeni konke kwetayeri lemoto encane?
question.st: Ke bofe boteng bo tlase bo semmuso ba tere bo hlokahalang bophareng kaofela le tikolohong ya tere ya koloi e nyane?
